data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English name Caedmon, meaning 'strong, battle-ready, or handsome'. This name is not of biblical origin, but is commonly used in the Christian community. The name Keven carries the meaning “Strong, handsome” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Keven usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Keven total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
